findings.body: This negative-control test changes only `WAREHOUSE_DRIVER` among the database/provider safety settings. It never checks altered `WAREHOUSE_PG_HOST`, `WAREHOUSE_PG_PORT`, `WAREHOUSE_PG_DATABASE`, `PGHOST`, `PGPORT`, `PGDATABASE`, `LLM_PROVIDER`, or `AUTH_OTP_MOCK`. Consequently, removing or relaxing any corresponding guard in `playwright.config.ts` would leave the named safety test green, even though the generated browser path performs ingestion writes without invoking the backend disposable-database guard and an incorrect provider could make external calls. Exercise each safety-critical setting through `configExit` so regressions are refused before servers or writes start.
findings.title: Not done: unsafe browser-proof destinations and providers are rejected
